chapter: Jack Carey, Red Allen and repertoire
title: Jack Carey's band, Punch and Red Allen
summary: Happy played with Jack Carey with Punch; Red Allen was a young boy then.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: I just have heard about that number. In fact, Clarence Williams played on a record of it, I think, with Bessie Smith, I believe. That's nice stuff. When did Jack Carey fit in there? I know you told me you were with Jack Carey. Yeah, I played with Jack Carey. Good luck. Was Punch with him then or was that before Punch?
That was with Punch. And a little before he took Punch.
Punch we had Allen. We had Allen. We had Tucker. They tell me Tucker's feeling better now. Yeah, that's good. They don't drink anymore.
How old was Allen at that time? Red Allen. Mm-hmm. How old was Red Allen then? I don't know.
